title: Environment Controller | Lighting | Graphics + More
features:
Make your gameplay absolute peak with the Environment Controller by Incognito! Change, brightness, saturation, fog, environment color, and much more!

Some features include but are not limited to:
Lighting brightness control
Time of day adjustment
Exposure control
Fog start/end distance
Fog colour customization
Global shadows toggle
Environment diffuse lighting
Environment specular lighting
Atmosphere density
Atmosphere haze
Atmosphere glare
Atmosphere and decay colour customization
Maximum Quality preset
Performance Mode preset
Saturation control
Contrast control
Colour brightness control
Colour tint customization
Bloom intensity and size
Blur effect
Sun rays effect
